items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Mercer Ellington, he used to buy me cigars... I can't understand why no one would call on me -- ... They know how I -- how close I was with Duke, and knew everything and even Mercer

ctx.x: We were just sitting here talking and you were just telling me about, I used to smoke them good cigars.

Mercer Ellington, he used to buy me cigars, they cost $34 a box and I got to liking them see, and one day -- I liked my I.W. Harper also. 100 proof, if you ain't got 100 proof, I don't drink. I know I was down in Texas, Galveston, Duke and I and we went to this lady's house and I always used to carry a fifth of bourbon with me, so we went in this lady's house to have dinner or I guess it was dinner and she didn't have any bourbon so I went and got my

bourbon out of the bag and started drinking it and the woman says, how dare you bring that whiskey in my house. I said, well, I didn't want to insult you but I don't drink this whiskey you have so I had some and I thought I'd bring it in quietly and drink a little. So that was the end of that. She bawled me out. I said I'm sorry and I didn't mean any harm.
